known_limitations: A level_confirmed PASS covers one metric on one stored frame at one V/div and offset setting; it is a self-consistency check against the instrument's own reading, never a calibration against a traceable reference.
level_confirmed is UNKNOWN whenever the capture records no instrument measurement or records one under a metric outside PKPK, top and base.
A width-2 (WORD or left-aligned 16-bit) capture stays in the code domain until an external calibration file binds the scale to that record's SHA-256.
Clipping is only observable up to the representable code range; a floating-point record with no declared ADC rails cannot establish either outcome and reports rail_bounds_unknown.

Structural completeness is scoped to the stored record: whole-screen coverage, acquisition-memory extent, same-frame identity and trigger or wall-clock alignment stay UNVERIFIED because no accepted input carries a frame identifier.
Units, probe attenuation and signal names are not inferable from the samples; a capture that records none leaves them unknown.
Every list output is bounded: edge, cycle, event and JSON budgets yield explicit lower bounds or prefixes beside an authoritative count.
ringing and candidate-window review are bounded local observations, not proof that a physical event ended or that no other candidate exists.
Nothing here repairs a capture; an INCOMPLETE or mismatched record is refused at load time and must be re-captured by the device-control Skill.
